articles.author: Filip Cleeren
articles.title: F1 signs historic 10-year Rwanda deal to host African Grand Prix - Motorsport.com
articles.description: Formula 1 has confirmed it has concluded a 10-year deal with Rwanda to host the African Grand Prix by 2030.
articles.content:
The government of Rwanda and Formula 1 have announced a 10-year deal for a new African Grand Prix in the capital Kigali, which will first be held in 2030 at the earliest.
